premises.text: Huge idle bike stock exists that can become the world's largest rental fleet if connected
premises.evidence_span: the largest bike rental system in the world already exists. We just need to connect it

premises.text: Shop rentals and public bike share are expensive or poorly suited for leisure rides
premises.evidence_span: a bike rental in New York City or San Francisco currently costs between $40 and $60 a day

premises.text: Web marketplace lists owner bikes with photos, location, price, review, filters, and social proof
premises.evidence_span: taking this excess supply of bicycles and meeting it with the demand

premises.text: Average SpinLister prices are about half of shop rentals with a wide price range
premises.evidence_span: Our average price on SpinLister right now is about $20 a day, about half of existing bike rental shop prices

premises.text: Platform facilitates owner-renter conversation with insurance up to $5,000 and institutional coverage
Infrastructure-light, location-independent model can expand city-to-city and internationally
premises.evidence_span: in a location-independent way that is extremely infrastructure-light

value.text: Let travelers and locals rent individual owners' bikes to explore more cheaply and personally
value.evidence_span: we allow individual bike owners to rent out their bikes to travelers and locals looking to explore

secondary_value.text: Social connection and personalized local tips around a shared bike interest
secondary_value.evidence_span: allow people to connect over a bicycle, this common interest

causal_links.evidence_span: about half of existing bike rental shop prices
We have enough rules in place to make it safe

notes: Audience-choice win and listing counts treated as traction evidence, not premises. Listing UX details folded into marketplace premise. Mobile app/national launch as GTM roadmap folded into expansion domain.
